name: intelligence
description: The sensors regulator watch runs (#123): S4 without a model. Each is a declared part of the definition — a program over the instance on a schedule, or a glob over its files — that raises the same intelligence-signal a research unit raises through report_intelligence, under its own provenance, naming the unit types it bears on; the router opens the obligation, the veto holds the type at dispatch, and nothing replans. The three here are the portfolio workload's. Every threshold and interval below is the definition's claim about what matters, not evidence that it does: the drift band is benchmark.json's, the harvest minimum is this file's, the expiries are a guess at how long a reading stays current.

sensors.name: drift-band
sensors.description: A weight at the latest custodian's export, valued at that date's prices, further from the latest target on or before it than the rebalance band benchmark.json declares. Reads positions/, prices/, targets/ and benchmark.json through lib/portfolio.js and writes nothing. The portfolio note's S4 item 1, first case.

sensors.name: harvest-threshold
sensors.description: An open lot whose unrealised loss at the latest prices, valued at the rate tax.json applies to it (long-term after the cutoff, short-term before), exceeds the minimum the argv declares in dollars. The minimum lives here until the harvest contract's costs file (#124) is the place to read it from. Reads lots/, positions/, prices/ and tax.json and writes nothing.

sensors.name: new-export
sensors.description: A new file under positions/ or prices/: the custodian's export landed, and the lots and the review are behind it. The event the finance example named as the short extension of regulator watch.
